GF-T8: an exponent in trits

You will learn

How GF-T keeps the phi split but stores the exponent in balanced trits: 1 + 3 trits + 4 bits.

GF-T is GoldenFloat with a ternary exponent. GF-T8 has 1 sign, 3 exponent trits and 4 mantissa bits. Three trits give 27 exponent values, offset 13 makes them balanced around zero, and offset 26 is kept as the one non-finite value. The spec tests the split as E / M in thousandths: 3000 / 4 = 750.

Try it

Run the two tests of gft8.t27. Then find exp_values and is_finite and say which offset is not finite.
